components.label: Base / pan chassis
components.purpose: Fixed lower body, connector platform and pan-axis base.
components.limits: Overall 163 × 199 × 231 mm envelope is published; curves and seam placement are approximate.

components.label: Pan axis
components.purpose: Rotates the upper camera assembly horizontally.
components.limits: Published travel ±175°. Training slider is bounded to that range.

components.label: Tilt axis / camera head
components.purpose: Tilts the lens head independently of the pan base.
components.limits: Published tilt travel +90° to -30°. Geometry is reconstructed from product imagery.

components.label: 20× optical lens
components.purpose: 4.4–88.4 mm zoom lens. Tele Convert can extend equivalent HD framing using sensor crop.
components.limits: Do not describe Tele Convert as a 40× optical lens; native optical zoom is about 20×.

components.label: 360° mohawk tally
components.purpose: Bi-colour overhead tally visible around the camera head.
components.limits: Illumination is simulated and is not the venue’s current tally state.

components.label: Rear illuminated camera ID
components.purpose: Removable illuminated number provides rear camera identification.
components.limits: Training number is synthetic and does not assert a saved FMP camera ID.

components.label: 5-line RGB OLED
components.purpose: Displays device/network/video information locally on the base.
components.limits: Training text uses synthetic values; no FMP IP or firmware is embedded.

components.label: IR sensor
components.purpose: Receives commands from the supported IR remote.
components.limits: No remote configuration is modeled.
